verdict.rationale: Canva exposes a broad programmatic surface. The Connect APIs cover syncing assets, designs and comments, autofilling Brand Templates, resizing and exporting. The MCP server adds natural-language design generation, targeted editing, discovery, asset/brand management, export and comments. Admin, SCIM and audit-log APIs cover org management. However, nothing documents parity with the full editor UI: in-editor element manipulation runs through the Apps SDK inside the editor, not a headless API, and some capabilities are plan-gated (resize on Pro+, private integrations on Enterprise). Missing for 10: any documented claim or evidence of UI-to-API parity, headless fine-grained element-level editing, availability not gated by plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage.
